I have kept my own seeds from last season for this plot, and I will spread some manure from my cattle to make the soil strong. Chemical fertilizer is too expensive and difficult to find here in Kaskazini Pemba, so I will not use it. My family will clear the weeds and tend the plot by hand when the rains come, and we do not need to hire anyone for such a small piece of land.
